english.note: Use this as the everyday choice for something available through the Internet, such as 網上購物 or 網上服務.
Use this when “virtual” means online or remote, contrasting internet-based activity with meeting in person; it does not specifically imply computer simulation.

examples.english: I often buy daily necessities online.
examples.traditional: 我成日喺網上買日用品。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 maai5 jat6 jung6 ban2

examples.english: The lecture is virtual this time, so nobody has to go to school.
examples.traditional: 今次個講座網上舉行，大家唔使返學校。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 gong2 zo6 mong5 soeng6 geoi2 hang4 daai6 gaa1 m4 sai2 faan1 hok6 haau6
